# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 14 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_014_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 14

**14:1** Joseph was terrified. He backed away from Mary and sat alone, trying to think through what to do. He turned it over in his mind: "If I cover this up, I'm breaking God's law. But if I report her to the people, what if what's inside her is from an angel? Then I'd be sending an innocent woman to her death. There's no good option. I'll just quietly let her go."

**14:2** That night, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream. "Joseph, don't be afraid because of this child. What has been conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit. She will give birth to a son. Name him Jesus — because he will save his people from their sins."

**14:3** Joseph woke up, his heart overflowing with praise to the God of Israel for giving him this revelation. He took Mary back under his care and kept her safe.
